title: Histogram Content, Version 1
description: The content of the role histogram of a nemar.histogram view: counts per bin, with the bins given either as numeric edges, where bin i holds e_i <= v < e_(i+1) and the last bin also holds v equal to the last edge, or as named categories. Its shape is the shape of a dataQuality distribution's histogram, with an optional unit; either form may count the values that were missing or not a number (missing). The root is open: a preset over nemar.histogram may add members of its own, and a renderer that draws the preset by this base reads only the members below. docs/views/generic-kinds.md gives the model and the rules JSON Schema cannot state: edges strictly increasing, and one count per bin.

edges.description: Bin edges, strictly increasing; one more than the counts. At most 1,024 bins (views/registry.json caps.entries_per_dim).

categories.description: Bin names, in drawing order, with no TAB, CR or LF; as many as the counts.

counts.description: Count per bin, in bin order, at most 2^53 - 1 so that every JSON parser reads it exactly.

unit.description: Unit of the binned values; edge bins only.

missing.description: Values that were missing or not a number, so in no bin, counted apart (in either form); a renderer shows the count beside the bars, never as one.

oneOf.description: Bins by category: no edges, no underflow or overflow, and no unit.
